reasoning_traces.think:
The core challenge is mapping procedural flowcharts into stochastic dynamical systems. Each block becomes a transition kernel acting on probability measures over state spaces. The key failure mode occurs when block dependencies create feedback loops, leading to non-convergent fixed-point equations. In GSI, this maps directly onto belief propagation in graphical models; in GSE, it manifests as catastrophic forgetting in recurrent neural networks. To prevent anti-collinearity, we impose sparsity constraints on transition matrices, ensuring each block contributes unique information.
